key_highlights: ASX sheds $90b in a week on rate rise fears and oil price surge, signalling broad-based risk-off
AUD smashed as growth scare builds, pressuring importers and rate-sensitive sectors
Iron ore enters 'bloodletting' phase, hitting BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX directly
Oil explodes as price suppression fails; Australian fuel prices set to rise 30c, pressuring WES.AX, QAN.AX
RBA flagged rental inflation as key concern, complicating rate path and housing outlook
ANZ.AX axing 3,500 jobs signals structural cost pressure across banking sector
Housing prices crash with first-home buyer surge; no spring bounce in auction market
Mining cap raises intensify (Canaccord-led), small-caps PolarX, Sunstone Metals, Manuka Resources in focus
Santos (STO.AX) preservation raises questions on energy sector policy support
Australian business confidence deteriorating; one flight cancelled every three days on staff shortages

sectors.trend: Iron ore in active 'bloodletting'; small-cap miners (PolarX, Sunstone, Manuka) showing relative strength via cap raises; gold underperforming ('gold schmould')
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure from falling iron ore; small-caps offer speculative upside but elevated dilution risk via cap raises

sectors.trend: ANZ.AX cutting 3,500 jobs signals industry-wide cost discipline; RBA rental inflation concern may delay rate cuts, supporting NIMs but pressuring credit growth
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX benefit from sustained higher rates but face credit risk from housing correction; ANZ.AX restructuring may be a laggard catalyst

sectors.trend: Oil spike and fuel price rise (30c) create headwinds for consumers; Santos preservation signals policy support for domestic energy
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, STO.AX benefit from oil strength; QAN.AX, SYD.AX face margin compression from fuel costs; WES.AX squeezed on input costs

sectors.trend: Woolworths (WES.AX) breached price freeze on staples; business confidence deteriorating; housing correction boosting first-home buyers but overall demand soft
sectors.implications: WES.AX, CPL.AX face margin pressure; housing-linked retailers (WBC.AX, IAG.AX) see mixed signals from buyer surge vs. price crash

sectors.trend: Neurizon (NEU.AX) among ASX runners; AI development slowdown calls from global tech execs; McGrath Foundation funding shift
sectors.implications: CSL.AX remains defensive anchor; NEU.AX and small-cap tech offer speculative plays; AI slowdown may pressure global tech multiples

sectors.trend: Housing prices crashing; rental inflation flagged by RBA; new social rental builds in Perth; NZ housing correction still running
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face rental yield compression vs. occupancy risk; property developers under pressure; social housing policy tailwind for select names

key_themes: Rate rise fears and AUD weakness driving broad ASX selloff ($90b weekly loss)
Commodity divergence: oil up, iron ore down, gold weak
Housing correction accelerating with policy and RBA rental inflation focus
Mining cap raise cycle intensifying, small-cap dilution risk
Energy policy support (Santos) vs. consumer fuel cost pressure
Superannuation system under political and structural scrutiny
Business confidence and labour shortages (aviation) as macro headwinds

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hike / delayed cuts amid rental inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight financials (NIM support), underweight rate-sensitive REITs and property developers
Reduce exposure to BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold or energy hedges

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil spike and fuel cost inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge transport and consumer staples exposure; favour WDS.AX, WLE.AX as beneficiaries
Reduce foreign-currency-denominated liabilities; favour domestic-revenue ASX names
Underweight property developers; monitor REIT occupancy; favour social housing policy beneficiaries
Avoid small-cap miners in active cap raise cycles; focus on cash-flow-positive producers

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy producers on oil spike
opportunities.rationale: Oil price surge and fuel cost inflation favour upstream producers; Santos policy support adds tailwind

opportunities.recommendation: Selective banking exposure on rate support
opportunities.rationale: RBA rental inflation concern delays cuts, supporting NIMs; ANZ restructuring may create entry point
CSL.AX and high-dividend names offer stability amid $90b ASX selloff and growth scare

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore and materials exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Active iron ore bloodletting and weak gold create downside risk for miners

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD weakness and rate risk
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD smashed on growth scare; rising rate fears pressure equities broadly
Housing crash and rental inflation create occupancy and yield compression risk

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. $90b weekly ASX loss, AUD weakness, oil spike, and iron ore decline create a risk-off environment. RBA rental inflation focus complicates rate-cut expectations. Expect continued volatility in ^AX20 and ^AORD over 1-3 months.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Housing correction may stabilise, banking NIMs remain supported, and energy transition (Santos support) offers structural upside. Iron ore oversupply is a medium-term headwind for miners. Superannuation reform debate could create policy tailwinds for financials.

Brent crude and Australian fuel pump prices
CoreLogic and REINZ housing price indices
ASX small-cap cap raise activity (Canaccord pipeline)
Global AI regulation and tech earnings
